author: soraboss
body: Look I don't know what to say, I'm getting kicked out for not hacking. Can I just come back for a test at least. I don't want to go. What harm will it cause if I am there or not. If I say I won't hack and you can watch me when ever you want. I lag I know that but in that video I went frame by frame to find the confusion, but there was never any real evidence. you say you got other evidence no recorded, but that's nothing. Because to me It seems that some people want me gone because I killed them and they want to be the best. Look I'm sorry kycrafft I didn't mean the female part was disgusting, I was meaning the fact I thought you hacked, because when I fought you It looked like hacks and that's the same with a lot of people. I know I'm not the best pvper my KD is 1.05 which is nothing compared to some peoples 3.48. I mean I don't really see a problem with bringing me back in. If I go on high alert and anyone can call hacks and I get banned forever that time. Just please. One person on your server is nothing, so why not give it a try. don't just ban me and block me from commenting like you are done with the whole thing, because that looks like you trying to hind something. Look i'm not angry at anyone in particular. I know I seem mean to kycrafft, but I'm sure he / she is great. Can I not just prove to you guys that I am real and you let me back I play you find nothing wrong and then go back to normal? I know that isn't how thing are meant to work, but come on does someone who hack and hate your server try this hard to get back? I'll do anything; I'll record, take screenshots, stream, just what ever. I don't find this fair. I don't know what to do because I can't prove anything. btw if you were meaning I lied about the I've been here for two years thing, that is true. I came on this server ages ago and then left and never came back till now when I refound it. This is an amazing server, but I wish you could treat me better, saying you lied and this video i made shows you got two kills banned. is not a good response.
